contrast: within-gene TM windows minus cytoplasmic windows

cohort_manifest.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted selected accessions, input SHA-256 values, and min_aa

estimator.pairing: TM and cytoplasmic topology windows from the same accession
estimator.window_statistic: arithmetic mean adjacent-codon-pair shell per exact topology span
estimator.gene_contrast: arithmetic mean(TM window shells) minus arithmetic mean(cytoplasmic window shells)
estimator.coordinate_policy: UniProt 1-based inclusive spans must fall wholly within the translated CDS; invalid or out-of-range spans are excluded and never clipped
estimator.terminal_span_rule: exclude invalid, out-of-range, singleton, or below-min-aa spans; score only exact retained spans
estimator.translated_stop_codon_rule: a terminal stop codon is excluded from the translated residue count

aa_null_reference.note: computed by script_2_null.py on the exact selected atlas cohort
